data.name: Chronostasis
data.detailed_description:
Chronostasis is a character action game where you play as Shion, a mysterious scythe-wielding android, as she battles through multiple waves fighting against other robotic enemy creatures, called the Synths, both for aggressive style and for your survival.

Gameplay Overview

Take your skills to the test and fight against waves of enemies. Damage them with your scythe, block or dodge incoming attacks, and keep yourself alive for as many waves as you can.

As the waves progress, the difficulty increases and the enemies get harder and harder to overcome. But if you play your cards right, you may be able to survive with only a few scratches.

When defeating enemies, replenish your Chrono gauge to the max, then overclock and activate Chronostasis to stop all enemies in their tracks! Use it to give yourself a breather and heal yourself back up, or double-down and make sure your opponents stay down.

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1300x
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
